name: ParallaxLayers
description: A self-contained smooth-scroll scene where up to five decorative planes (glow orbs, rings, glass cards, dots and sparks) translate at different fractions of the scroll distance behind native-speed headlines, creating layered depth.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" with an aria-label, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrows/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) and see a 2px :focus-visible outline. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the top/bottom edge wheel events are released so the page keeps scrolling. Touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Under prefers-reduced-motion (or smooth=false) the wheel is not intercepted at all. All parallax shapes are aria-hidden; only the headline and statements are exposed. Under prefers-reduced-motion the layers stay static.

defaultProps.title: Depth in motion
defaultProps.subtitle: Five planes drift at five speeds. Scroll inside to feel the space open up.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Headline shown on the first screen.

propsApi.name: subtitle
propsApi.default: 'Five planes drift at five speeds. Scroll inside to feel the space open up.'

propsApi.name: layers
propsApi.description: Number of depth layers (2–5), sampled from back to front.

propsApi.name: depth
propsApi.description: Multiplier for the speed difference between layers (0 disables parallax).

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
